annotator.method: Claude read frames sampled every 20 frames (0.67 s) from each evaluation clip, with denser frames near the signal change for clips L, N and Q. The sheets showed the stop line and enlarged signal heads, and no tracker or rule output.
known_limits: Not independent ground truth: the annotator also wrote the rule and declared the geometry, and had seen each clip's median image while doing so.
The source is a compilation of red-light running, so the annotator expected violations in most clips.
Frame and x are estimates read from images: about +/-10 frames and +/-60 px.
A fast vehicle could pass unnoticed between two samples, though every vehicle seen here stayed in view longer than that.

protocol.violation: The front of a vehicle crosses the stop line while the signal of its lane is red, and the vehicle continues into the junction. 'frame' is the estimated crossing of the front, and 'x' is the box center at that moment.
protocol.not_violation: A notable case the rule should not flag: stopped with the front on the line, or entered on yellow. Listed so that a false positive can be named; any other unmatched candidate is a false positive too.
protocol.uncertain: The truth cannot be determined from the video: for example a vehicle in the right-turn lane that leaves through the image edge, or a vehicle already across the line when the clip starts, when the signal at its entry is not visible. Excluded from precision and recall, and counted separately.

matching.assignment: Each label is matched to at most one candidate, in order of increasing frame difference.
matching.true_positive: A candidate matched to a 'violation' label.
matching.false_positive: A candidate matched to a 'not_violation' label, or to no label.
matching.ignored: A candidate matched to an 'uncertain' label.
matching.false_negative: A 'violation' label with no matched candidate.

signal_scoring: A reader's state is compared with the intervals below at the sampled frames (every 20 frames from the clip start). Frames outside every interval are in a signal change and are not scored.
